name: Select-before-operate command interface
aliases: substations Substation automation and command interfaces
summary: Separates equipment selection from the subsequent operating request in the selected control scheme.
description: Separates equipment selection from the subsequent operating request in the selected control scheme. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Selection and operate requests” at the input and “Selected equipment command” at the output. The exact control model is device-specific.
